children: Cannabis company Cannara Biotech has appointed former Organigram executive Nicholas Fozard as chief financial officer.

Fozard brings cannabis-sector finance experience, a background in public-company reporting, manufacturing finance, capital markets and transactions. He succeeds Nicholas Sosiak, who in April became chief operating officer and has been transitioning from the finance chief role held since 2020.
Fozard's appointment will take effect with his receipt of a Health Canada security clearance required of all officers and directors of the company.
Fozard previously served as vice president of finance at Organigram Global and senior vice president of finance at iAnthus.
